topic: fix a phone battery that's draining unusually fast
core_question: Why is my phone's battery draining so quickly, and how do I fix it? (secondary: What's the right way to store a lithium battery I won't use for a while?)
answer_summary: Open Settings > Battery > Battery Usage to identify which app is draining power, then close, limit background activity for, or update that app.; after the topic shift: Charge the lithium-ion battery to roughly 50%, then store it in a cool, dry place away from heat, rechecking/topping up the charge every few months.
